lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular nodes are organized in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. A central cluster of nodes forms a recognizable triangular configuration near the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular nodes to create a grid-like visual structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges on the upper flank exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by a high-intensity dorsal edge and a low-intensity (shadowed) ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs, primarily concentrated on the anterior half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-intensity spots, which appear more concentrated than the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
